item.title: A cruise ship sold as a forever home left 203 residents in Cambodia as Iran war fuel costs hit up to $8,000 a cabin
item.description: Fuel for each cabin rose from $1,800 to as much as $8,000 a month, and founder Mikael Petterson says the Iran war broke the business.

item.title: Elon Musk spent at least $225 million in Texas. The governor-elect who sued for Abbott emails and vowed a data center freeze won anyway
item.description: Hinojosa has questioned a $1.66 billion tax break for Musk’s $16.8 billion Terafab chip plant, and Democrats now control the Texas House.

item.title: OpenAI’s Dots are coming up against the price of privacy, and the price of compute
item.description: OpenAI took its Dev Day roadshow to London this week, attempting to sell the city’s developers on Dots, the company’s new, always-on AI assistant.
